claims.claim: A petition to reinstate Jensen Huang passed 100,000 signatures on Saturday, including 5,248 people who said they are current Nvidia employees.
claims.episode_span: passed 100,000 signatures on Saturday, The Information reported, including 5,248 people
claims.source_title: Thousands of Nvidia Staff Sign Petition to Bring Back Huang
claims.supporting_quote: A petition urging Nvidia’s board to reinstate Jensen Huang passed 100,000 signatures Saturday, including 5,248 people who said they are current Nvidia employees.

claims.claim: Signers include Elon Musk, Tim Sweeney and Garry Tan.
claims.episode_span: Signers named there include Elon Musk, Epic Games’ Tim Sweeney and Y Combinator’s Garry Tan.
claims.source_title: Thousands of Nvidia Staff Sign Petition to Bring Back Huang
claims.supporting_quote: Signers include Elon Musk, Epic Games’ Tim Sweeney and Y Combinator’s Garry Tan.

claims.claim: By Saturday afternoon the petition had more than 115,000 signatures, including 5,965 current employees, 1,108 former employees and 63,063 shareholders.
claims.episode_span: By Saturday afternoon TechCrunch put the total above 115,000, with the petition site listing 5,965 current employees, 1,108 former employees and 63,063 shareholders
claims.source_title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
claims.supporting_quote: The petition website said the signers include 5,965 current Nvidia employees, 1,108 former employees, and 63,063 shareholders.

claims.claim: Notable supporters include Amjad Masad, and the petition says Huang was removed without meaningful due process and deserves due process, not mob justice.
claims.episode_span: plus Replit CEO Amjad Masad among notable supporters
claims.source_title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
claims.supporting_quote: “Jensen deserves due process, not mob justice,” the petition says.

claims.claim: Huang resigned Thursday, four days after confessing to an affair with a chip executive suspected by U.S. intelligence of being a Chinese spy, and agreed to testify before Congress.
claims.episode_span: Huang resigned Thursday, four days after confessing to an affair with a chip executive suspected by U.S. intelligence of being a Chinese spy
claims.source_title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
claims.supporting_quote: Huang resigned on Thursday , four days after confessing to having an affair with a chip executive suspected by U.S. intelligence to be a Chinese spy.

claims.supporting_quote: Nvidia appointed CFO Colette Kress as the company’s interim CEO while it searches for a permanent replacement.

claims.claim: Nvidia’s security chief quietly left in August.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 disruption lasted about 30 hours, was tied to an earlier network capacity upgrade, and Microsoft promised a preliminary report within two business days and a final report within five.

claims.supporting_quote: The disruption lasted about 30 hours, according to Microsofts incident log .

claims.claim: Microsoft reported in January more than 450 million paid commercial Microsoft 365 seats, and this was at least the fourth significant outage of the year.
claims.episode_span: more than 450 million paid commercial Microsoft 365 seats

claims.supporting_quote: Microsoft reported in January that it had more than 450 million paid commercial Microsoft 365 seats, roughly one for every 18 people on Earth.
